warband.name: The Sons of Hashut
warband.rules: Chaos Dwarf slavers of Hashut. Hard Head: Chaos Dwarfs & Bull Centaurs ignore the special rules of maces, clubs and hammers. Armour: Chaos Dwarfs & Bull Centaurs never suffer movement penalties for wearing armour. Hard to Kill: Chaos Dwarfs & Bull Centaurs are taken out of action only on a 6 (Injury 1-2 = knocked down, 3-5 = stunned, 6 = OOA). Slavers: Captured fighters are never freed — sacrifice them (Apprentice Sorcerer +1 Experience each) or put them to work (+1 wyrdstone each, then D6: 2-6 the captive dies and you keep its equipment; 1 it escapes). Uncommon: Chaos Dwarf recruits cost 1.5× the usual Experience for veterancy (rounding up); Hobgoblins are normal. Indentured Servants: The warband must include at least four Hobgoblins; while below four you may recruit only Hobgoblins. Hired Swords: May hire the Hired Swords open to all warbands or to Orc & Chaos warbands, and also these – Ogre Bodyguard, Pit Fighter, Warlock, Imperial Assassin, Hobgoblin Scout. Never any Elves of any sort.

units.name: Apprentice Sorcerer
units.sp: Leader: Friendly models within 6" may use his Leadership. Wizard: Uses Chaos Dwarf Magic — he cannot cast spells while wearing armour. Hard Head. Hard to Kill. Armour: Never suffers movement penalties for wearing armour.

units.name: Bull Centaur
units.sp: Large Target. Hard Head. Hard to Kill. Armour: Never suffers movement penalties for wearing armour.

units.name: Chaos Dwarf Champion
units.sp: Hard Head. Hard to Kill. Armour: Never suffers movement penalties for wearing armour.

units.name: Chaos Dwarf Warrior
units.sp: Hard Head. Hard to Kill. Armour: Never suffers movement penalties for wearing armour.

units.name: Chaos Dwarf Blunderbusser
units.sp: Hard Head. Hard to Kill. May carry a Chaos Dwarf Blunderbuss. Armour: Never suffers movement penalties for wearing armour.

units.name: Hobgoblin
units.sp: Skinny: On a Serious Injury roll of 1-3 the Hobgoblin leaves the warband. Nobody cares: Counts as half a model when making Rout tests. Cannot be promoted to Hero.

chaosDwarfSkills.name: Chaos Dwarf Skills
chaosDwarfSkills.note: Apprentice Sorcerer, Champions & Bull Centaur (instead of one of the standard tables).
skills: When rolling on the Injury table for this warrior, treat 1-3 as knocked down, 4-5 as stunned and only 6 as out of action.
After the battle the warrior may re-roll one of his Serious Injury results; the second result stands.
The warrior Hates all enemies (re-roll missed to-hit rolls in the first turn of every close combat).
3+ save on a D6 to avoid being stunned (a stun becomes knocked down instead). With a helmet this save is 2+ and replaces the normal helmet rule.

intro.text: The Chaos Dwarfs of Zharr-Naggrund have ruled slaves for millennia. A Hashut sorcerer who learned of the fall of Mordheim sends his servants after the witchstone and for rivals to defeat.

unitLore.sorcerer: Having served one of the powerful sorcerer lords of Zharr-Naggrund, the apprentices are eager to prove their worth and knowledge in the savage streets of Mordheim. Their sole ambition is to reach the level of their masters.
unitLore.bull: Bull Centaurs are Hashut’s chosen ones and are famous for being powerful and very dangerous adversaries. It is considered a great honor to include these allies in a band of Chaos Dwarfs.
unitLore.champion: They are the warriors favored by the sorcerer’s apprentices. They are excellent fighters and trustworthy sergeants.
